title: Return to the Whorl
author: Gene Wolfe
series: The Book of the Short Sun
note: conf=0.97; Third and final volume of Gene Wolfe's Book of the Short Sun trilogy, following On Blue's Waters and In Green's Jungles. ISBN 9780312873646 corresponds to the Tor hardcover edition (2001). The trilogy sits within the wider "Solar Cycle" (New Sun/Long Sun/Short Sun), but the tight sub-series is The Book of the Short Sun, #3.
